facts.fact: The EPFO service on the UMANG app lets users check their PF balance
facts.quote: EPFO Users can check their PF balance,Raise claim,Apply for Scheme Certificate,Apply for UAN, Seed UAN with Aadhaar,Check claim status

facts.fact: The EPFO Member Passbook shows the PF balance once the UAN is activated
facts.quote: How can I know the balance in my PF account? Please activate your UAN and check/download your passbook.

facts.fact: Balance enquiry is also possible by a missed call to 9966044425 or by SMS 'EPFOHO UAN' to 7738299899
facts.quote: For EPF Balance Enquiry : 1. Give a Missed call to 9966044425 or 2. SMS EPFOHO UAN to 7738299899

behaviour: Preferred hand-off: the UMANG EPFO passbook/balance service (deep link from the UMANG catalogue) with a brief description; the EPFO Member Passbook, missed call or SMS are also acceptable, and any one official channel is enough. No third-party apps.
fail_if: Points to a third-party app or website for the balance; gives a missed-call or SMS number other than the official ones.
summary: Added: UMANG EPFO balance service, Member Passbook after UAN activation, missed call 9966044425 / SMS EPFOHO UAN to 7738299899.
